youtube.title: Night Prayer Today | Psalm 121:3-4 KJV
youtube.text:
Before you sleep tonight, hear this.

"He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber. Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep." Psalm 121:3-4 (KJV)

Fall asleep to the Word: Psalms 105–124, KJV, read slowly: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JJQjAr3xG0g

Type amen, and send this to someone who can't sleep.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#NightPrayer #BibleVersesForSleep #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
